CustomField.description: Projected cash collection date. Basis-switching logic: if Invoice_Date__c is populated, it is used as the basis; otherwise Expected_Trigger_Date__c is used. The Opportunity's Net_Terms__c value is then translated to a day offset and added to that basis. Forecast treatment notes: discount terms (e.g., "Net 10 days, 2% discount") are treated conservatively at the discount day count (assumes customer takes the discount); end-of-month terms (e.g., "Net 30 EOM") are approximated as a fixed offset (precise EOM math is deferred); two-tier terms (e.g., "2/20 Net 90") are treated conservatively at the longer arm (assumes customer forgoes the discount). Custom or null terms default to 30 days. Read-only formula.
CustomField.formula: BLANKVALUE(Invoice_Date__c, Expected_Trigger_Date__c) + CASE( TEXT(Opportunity__r.Net_Terms__c), "Net 10 days, 2% discount", 10, "Net 15", 15, "Net 30", 30, "Net 30 EOM", 45, "Net 45", 45, "Net 60", 60, "Net 75", 75, "Net 90", 90, "2/20 Net 90", 90, 30 )
CustomField.label: Expected Payment Date
